QuestInfo.name: [Afterword] A World in Motion
QuestInfo.0: Meet and talk to #bFlying Fish, who now looks like Jean,#k in #bMorass#k.
QuestInfo.1: Flying Fish, who now looks like Jean, said everything is over since the Black Mage disappeared. He suggests to send this news to the others met in the Arcane River. #bGo up the Arcane River and meet the people you met so far#k as Jean said.
QuestInfo.2: The Arcane River will eventually disappear since the Black Mage is gone. According to Flying Fish, who now looks like Jean, the Arcane River will be absorbed by Maple World over centuries. The Arcane River that temporarily separated from Maple World will unite with Maple World once more.
